lines.t: Verse 1
He walked the earth in love and grace,
The Word made flesh, to take our place.
He healed the sick, the blind could see,
And cried, “Repent, and follow Me.”
“YaHuWaH” gave His Son to die,
That none be lost, that life draw nigh. (John 3:16)
No endless pain, no hopeless cries —
The wicked perish; truth defies.
Chorus
Blotted out, gone forever,
The proud shall fall, remembered never.
From dust we came, to dust return,
The fire refines, the chaff shall burn. (Malachi 4:1-3)
But life He gives to all who hear,
YahuShua’s call so strong, so clear.
Cry Little Sister section (for cinematic effect)
Come to the Light,
Escape the night —
No torment waits,
Just death or life! (Romans 6:23)
Verse 2
The dead know nothing, still and cold, (Ecclesiastes 9:5)
Not tortured flames as we’ve been told.
The wages paid for wicked ways —
An end of breath, no Song is Heard from the grave 🪦 (Romans 6:23)
The lake of fire, the second death,
Where YAH withdraws His gift of breath. (Revelation 20:14-15)
No life in pain, no scream, no sore —
The soul consumed, to be no more. (Matthew 10:28)
Bridge
The early saints would never teach
A fiery hell no hand could reach.
They spoke the truth with steadfast tone:
“The wicked fade, their breath is gone.” (Psalm 37:10, 20)
YahuShua weeps for those astray,
He calls them home — He is the Way.
He warns in love, “Turn, and be wise,
For sin shall burn, then flame shall die.” (Malachi 4:1)
Chorus
Blotted out, gone forever,
The proud shall fall, remembered never.
From dust we came, to dust return,
The fire refines, the chaff shall burn.
But life He gives to all who hear,
YahuShua’s call so strong, so clear.
Come to the Light,
Escape the night,
No torment waits,
Just death or Life!
Final Verse (Tag)
So fear the One who gives and takes, (Matthew 10:28)
Who wakes the soul, whose mercy breaks.
He longs to cleanse from every sin,
But those who mock won’t enter in.
The Book is opened, hearts are weighed,
The righteous rise, the lost shall fade.
So choose the life He came to call —
Receive His Flame, surrender all. (Deuteronomy 30:19)
